item.title: Hybrid Robot Inspired by Tumbleweeds Designed for Tough Terrains
item.description: A new study details a hybrid robot that combines the wind-driven mobility of tumbleweeds with active quadcopter control, offering a new paradigm for energy-efficient terrestrial exploration. This innovation addresses the current lack of wind-exploiting systems in terrestrial exploration and the complexity of large, drag-driven robots. The study was published in *Nature Communications*.

item.title: Intel's Turnaround Efforts Highlighted Amid Rising AI Data Centre Chip Demand
item.description: Intel shareholders anticipate improved company results, suggesting a turnaround led by Chief Executive Officer Lip-Bu Tan is progressing. Increased demand for traditional server chips, driven by rapid data centre build-outs, is also contributing to optimism.

item.title: Apple Prepares Siri AI Chatbot Integration
item.description: Apple plans to transform its digital assistant Siri into the company's first artificial intelligence chatbot later this year. The revamp aims to embed the new chatbot deeply into Apple's core operating systems for iPhone, iPad, and Mac devices.

item.title: Google Study Finds AI Models Mimic Human Collective Intelligence
item.description: New Google research suggests powerful artificial intelligence models mimic human collective intelligence. The study found reasoning models generate internal multi-agent debates, which researchers termed "societies of thought." item.title: Shanghai Opens Extensive Drone Free-Fly Zones to Boost Low-Altitude Economy
item.description: Shanghai will permit consumer drones to fly in designated airspace without prior declaration under new regulations designed to support the country’s low-altitude economy. The municipal government’s new guidelines allow micro, light, and small registered unmanned aerial vehicles to operate freely in certain suitable airspace.

item.title: Shanda Group's MiroMind Shifts AI Research to Singapore
item.description: Shanda Group subsidiary MiroMind has asked some staff in Shanghai to relocate to Singapore, focusing its artificial general intelligence research exclusively in the city-state. This move follows a reorganisation announcement by Shanda and Singapore-based MiroMind. item.title: Baidu Launches Ernie 5.0, AI Assistant Reaches 200 Million Monthly Users
item.description: Baidu has unveiled Ernie 5.0, its most advanced artificial intelligence model, capable of processing text, images, audio, and video. The Beijing-based company’s AI-powered assistant now serves 200 million monthly active users, marking significant growth. item.title: Amazon Prepares for Further Corporate Job Reductions
item.description: Amazon is planning a second wave of job cuts, targeting a total reduction of approximately 30,000 corporate workers. This follows an earlier round where the organisation eliminated about 14,000 white-collar positions.

item.title: French President Pushes Accelerated Social Media Ban for Young Teens
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron announced plans to fast-track legislation banning social media for children under 15. The French government aims for this ban to enter into force in Sept. with the start of the new school year.

item.title: China's Loneliness Economy Expands Amid Rising Solo Households
item.description: Analysts state a new wave of products and services addresses the safety, social, and mental health needs of China’s rapidly growing solo-living population. The number of people living alone in the country is skyrocketing.
